name: Stargazer
summary: Some oracles seek meaning in the pattern of the stars across the night sky, the trails of comets, and the eternal orbits of the planets.

features.name: Recommended Mysteries
features.summary: dark tapestry, heavens, lore, nature, time.

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: A stargazer adds Knowledge (nature), Perception, and Survival to her list of class skills. These replace the additional class skills from her mystery.

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.summary: faerie fire (2nd), glitterdust (4th), guiding star (6th), wandering star motes (8th), meteor swarm (18th). These bonus spells replace the oracle’s mystery bonus spells at these levels.

features.name: Revelations
features.summary: A stargazer must take the following revelations at the listed levels. Guiding Star (Su) : As the heavens mystery revelation. You must take this revelation at 1st level. Star Chart (Ex) : As the heavens mystery revelation. You must take this revelation at 7th level.

resourceActions.label: Invoke guiding star

modes.label: Empower Spell
modes.summary: Cast one spell as though modified by Empower Spell without increasing its casting time or spell level.

modes.label: Extend Spell
modes.summary: Cast one spell as though modified by Extend Spell without increasing its casting time or spell level.

modes.label: Silent Spell
modes.summary: Cast one spell as though modified by Silent Spell without increasing its casting time or spell level.

modes.label: Still Spell
modes.summary: Cast one spell as though modified by Still Spell without increasing its casting time or spell level.

confirmations.label: I am outdoors at night and can see the night sky

resourceActions.summary: Once per night outdoors, apply one listed metamagic feat without increasing casting time or spell level.

resourceActions.label: Consult star chart
resourceActions.summary: Contemplate the chart for 10 minutes to gain the benefit of commune.

conditionalModifiers.label: Wisdom-based checks
conditionalModifiers.condition: The open night sky is visible

mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression is automated. Bespoke effects without a shared builder subsystem remain descriptive.
